title: Quantile contract tests + telemetry indexer for per-route/model/region p95-p99 dashboards
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Provide a durable, low-cost quantile indexing pipeline and a set of contract tests that make p95/p99 latency signals available and trustworthy per route / model / region. Deliverables: 1) a streaming "quantile-indexer" service that consumes request-level telemetry, emits per-minute p95/p99 rollups for route+model+region slices, and stores both raw sketch state and rollup deltas; 2) SDK + runtime instrumentation changes to tag telemetry with route/model/version/region metadata and lightweight HDR sketches; 3) dashboard templates (Grafana/Datadog) and a regression watcher that triggers alerts when slice p95 or p99 deviates from baseline by configurable thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Indexer emits p95 and p99 rollups for at least 95% of active slices (route+model+region) in staging within 10 minutes of rollout
Dashboards show per-slice p95/p99 timeseries with ability to pivot by route/model/region and compare against 7-day baseline
Quantile contract tests reproduce known synthetic regressions (1.2x median -> 1.5x p95) and cause regression watcher to open an incident in staging
Rollups are within +/-5ms of ground-truth p95 computed by offline replay on sampled traces for routes with >500 requests/min
Storage of sketch state and rollup deltas is resilient to transient consumer restarts (no data loss on consumer restart during 5m outage)
Docs and runbook updated with instrumenting checklist and alert playbook
tasks: Instrumentation: add HDR sketch exporter to runtime telemetry (C++/Rust path) and ensure route/model/version/region tags are propagated
Pipeline: create Kafka topic telemetry.quantiles.v1 and a schema with versioned sketch blobs
Indexer service: implement streaming aggregator with reservoir + t-digest/HDR support, incremental rollups, and protobuf storage format
Storage: integrate rollup writer to existing time-series store (long retention for baselines) and short-term blob store for sketch snapshots
Dashboards: author Grafana + Datadog templates and a per-slice explorer UI for Console team to embed
Regression watcher: implement baseline calculation (rolling 7d trimmed mean) and z-score + percentage delta alerting logic
Quantile contract tests: create load harness scenarios (tokens/sec patterns, kernelized synthetic latencies) and CI jobs that validate indexer outputs against replayed traces
E2E smoke: deploy to staging, run synthetic spike + cache-warm experiments, validate alerts and dashboard accuracy
decisions: Use HDR histogram for high-resolution p99 tracking on low-volume slices and t-digest for high-throughput slices to balance memory vs accuracy
Emit per-minute rollups (rather than per-5s) to limit cardinality and cost, with option to backfill high-res bursts via raw traces
Store sketches for 72 hours to enable on-demand detailed reconstruction and keep rollup metrics (p50/p95/p99) for 90 days for baseline comparisons
risks: Cardinality explosion if we index every route+model+version+region+api_key; need to cap and provide sampling/aggregation policy
Accuracy trade-offs between HDR and t-digest implementations across different request size distributions
Operational cost of storing sketches if retention is increased without a prune policy
dependencies: ENG-30777 (existing batching/throughput harness) - will be used to generate synthetic load
ENG-30127 (alerting baseline infra) - regression watcher will send signals to that system
infra/kafka (team:platform) - provisioning telemetry.quantiles.v1 topic and ACLs
